comment:
* Interface used by Manager interfaces that will use a {@link FeatureConnector} to connect to
 * remote ImsFeature Binder interfaces.

methods.name: void registerFeatureCallback(int slotId, IImsServiceFeatureCallback cb)
methods.comment:
* Register a callback for the slot specified so that the FeatureConnector can notify its
     * listener of changes.
     * @param slotId The slot the callback is registered for.
     * @param cb The callback that the FeatureConnector will use to update its state and notify
     *           its callback of changes.

methods.name: void unregisterFeatureCallback(IImsServiceFeatureCallback cb)
methods.comment:
* Unregister a previously registered callback due to the FeatureConnector disconnecting. *

* This does not need to be called if the callback was previously registered for a one * shot result. * @param cb The callback to unregister.

methods.name: void associate(ImsFeatureContainer container, int subId)
methods.comment:
* Associate this Manager instance with the IMS Binder interfaces specified. This is usually
     * done by creating a FeatureConnection instance with these interfaces.
     * @param container Contains all of the related interfaces attached to a specific ImsFeature.
     * @param subId The subscription ID that the IMS Feature is being created for.

methods.name: void invalidate()
methods.comment: * Invalidate the previously associated Binder interfaces set in {@link #associate}.

methods.name: void updateFeatureState(@ImsFeature.ImsState int state)
methods.comment: * Update the state of the remote ImsFeature associated with this Manager instance.

methods.name: void updateFeatureCapabilities(@ImsService.ImsServiceCapability long capabilities)
methods.comment: * Update the capabilities of the remove ImsFeature associated with this Manager instance.
